pose: The Lambeosaurus is leaning heavily on its front limbs, its massive hatchet-shaped crest tilted toward the muddy ground. It is using its broad, spatulate beak to plow through a pile of rotting conifer logs and wet ferns, tossing debris behind it in a desperate attempt to find its lost tooth. Its front feet are trampling the very area it just searched, turning the ground into a chaotic slurry of mud and wood chips. One side of its jaw is swollen, and its eyes are squinted in focus and mild agony. It lets out a long, low-frequency rumble that vibrates the surrounding ferns. There is no tooth visible in the scene; the dinosaur has completely buried the evidence of its loss under a layer of churned earth.

visual_logic.substrate: Slippery river mud and shattered, decaying logs

behavioral_intent: Chaotic and destructive searching. The dinosaur’s size and weight are working against it, turning the search site into a mess that the player will eventually need to 'excavate' or 'sift' through.
